title: AP CSA Advanced Practice & Exam Mastery
description: The endgame after Foundations and Core: hard tracing, exam-weight MCQs, advanced FRQ practice, error analysis, timed sets, and three full simulations plus a final master simulation. Original problems throughout; ~80% problem solving.
audience: Students who completed AP CSA Foundations and AP CSA Core and want exam-level performance: hard problems, mixed-topic transfer, and full exam simulations under real time pressure.
outcomes: Diagnose any exam item's mechanism and error class within seconds
Trace multi-concept programs with state tables and alias discipline
Implement exam-weight methods and classes from prose specifications
Repair subtle bugs: boundaries, accumulators, mutation, recursion
Bank partial credit on FRQs without cascading errors
Run full exam simulations with pacing, triage, and a debrief protocol
